metafields.value:
A unisex perfume is made for anyone who loves it, and many of the most interesting scents in our range sit outside the 'for him' or 'for her' labels. This edit gathers more than 290 shareable fragrances, from fresh herbal blends to deep oud and tobacco.

anatomē

The London house anatomē makes a collection of eaux de parfum named Balance, Energy, Focus, Order, Expression and Support. Each comes in a smaller size at £28 or a larger bottle at £125. Expression is oceanic, Support is herbaceous and green, and Energy is bright and fresh, so they are easy to wear every day.

Niche houses

Hemel's line includes Rosado (£49.99), a refined rose, and Patchouli For All (£61.99), rich and sophisticated. Mancera Intense Red Tobacco Extrait (£79.99) is powerful and smoky. Serge Lutens La Fille de Berlin (£44.99) is bold and elegant. Boucheron Rose d'Isparta (£63.99) is a full, elegant rose.

Oud, amber and musk

Guerlain Musc Noble (£74.99) is a smooth musk perfume, and Guerlain Épices Exquises (£86.99) adds warm spice. For oud, Montale Aoud Safran (£62.99) is bold and saffron-rich, and Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (£32.99) is rich and warm. Al Haramain Detour Noir (£19.99) is a smooth, low-cost way to start.

Scents don't belong to anyone, so follow your nose. Explore our niche perfume edit, the oud perfume page or the Fresh fragrances family. Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, and orders over £40 ship free.

Niche perfume comes from smaller, specialist houses that focus on unusual materials and bold compositions. This edit brings together more than 70 fragrances from Tiziana Terenzi, Hemel, anatomē, Montale, Mancera and Serge Lutens, most of them unisex.

Tiziana Terenzi extraits

Tiziana Terenzi makes its scents as extrait de parfum, a concentration richer than an eau de parfum. White Fire (£76.99) is clean and elegant, Kirke (£82.99) is bold and captivating, and Porpora (£99.99) is rich. Moro di Venezia (£99.99) is sophisticated, Orion (£109.99) is bold and refined, and Caput Mundi (£99.99) is warm with oud. The Linea TT bottles include Borelli (£132.99) and Orza (£164.99), and Deriva (£119.99) belongs to the Sea Stars Collection.

Hemel, Montale and Mancera

Hemel's 100 ml eaux de parfum include Valley of Diamond (£61.99), a sophisticated blend, and Amethyst Dream (£61.99), vibrant and floral. Montale Aoud Safran (£62.99) is bold and spicy, and Mancera Black Noir (£69.99) is dark and rich. Serge Lutens La Fille de Berlin (£44.99) is a bold, elegant rose.

A gentle start

If you're new to niche scents, anatomē's eaux de parfum start at £28 for a smaller size, with larger bottles at £125. Many niche houses work with amber, so our amber perfume edit is a good next step.

Explore the Amber fragrances family, our unisex perfume page or the Tiziana Terenzi brand page. Every bottle is 100% authentic and sent from the UK, and delivery is free on orders over £40.

Luxury gifts are for the moments that matter: milestone birthdays, anniversaries and the people who deserve something special. This edit gathers over 140 fragrances and skincare collections over £50, from niche extraits to designer classics.

Luxury perfume

Guerlain Oud Essentiel (125 ml, £94.99) is deep and elegant, Épices Exquises (£86.99) is warm and spicy, and Musc Noble (£74.99) is a smooth musk. Gucci Intense Oud (£73.99) is luxurious, Mancera Intense Red Tobacco Extrait (£79.99) is powerful and smoky, and Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold (£62.99) is rich and sensual. Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Toilette (125 ml, refillable, £66.99) and Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte (£55.99) round out the designer picks.

Sets to unwrap

anatomē's Parfum Travel (£125) is a discovery set made for travel, and The Gift of Good Sleep (£68) pairs a Somali Frankincense pillow spray with sleep care.

Skincare

A skincare gift set feels luxurious but practical. Highborn London's Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set (£95) covers morning and night, and the Scrub and Glow Luminosity Set (£89) brings two natural products for brighter-looking skin.

Explore our niche perfume edit, the oud perfume page or the £50 and over range. Every gift is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, and because it's over £40, delivery is free.

Floral is the biggest family on our shelf, and this floral perfume edit gathers more than 230 fragrances built around rose, jasmine and white flowers. Prices start with miniatures under £20, and every bottle is authentic and sent from our UK base. Use the filters to narrow by brand, price or size.

Rose and jasmine

Chloé leads with Rose Naturelle Intense, a natural rose accord with citrus and neroli, and Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense, which pairs luminous jasmine with sweet date. Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum blends jasmine and peach with a rose heart and warm amber. For a richer take, Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold mixes honey, saffron and jasmine over patchouli and leather, a Jean Paul perfume for women who like depth. Estée Lauder SpellBound pairs rose and jasmine with cardamom and vanilla.

Fruity and playful florals

If you prefer something lighter, Ariana Grande Thank U, Next brings pear, raspberry and rose with a creamy finish. Anna Sui Sky blends pear, lily of the valley and lotus, and Antonio Banderas Her Secret Temptation adds rose, jasmine and iris over vanilla at £20.99. DKNY Be Delicious Orchard Street and Calvin Klein Eternity are fresher everyday choices. Each is an easy floral perfume for every day, and a fine perfume for women. Our perfume for women page has more.

Unisex florals and minis

Hemel Valley of Diamond and Rosado offer unisex florals with woods and amber, ideal if you want a unisex perfume to share. To try several houses at once, a miniature perfume set from Chloé, Burberry or Calvin Klein is a smart start. Explore the rose range or our travel size and mini perfumes. Orders over £40 ship free across the UK.
